hero.heading: Built in the open, with you.
hero.lead: Crustates is open source under AGPLv3. Report bugs, write code, improve the docs, add an app to the catalog or help fund the work.
hero.emblemAlt: Crustates emblem: your own cloud, on your own hardware

issues.title: Good first issues
issues.body: Small, well-described tasks to get you started in the code or the docs.

signoff.title: Sign off your commits
signoff.body: We use a DCO, not a CLA. Add a sign-off line to each commit:

contributing.title: Read CONTRIBUTING
contributing.body: How to build, test and send a pull request, and how decisions are recorded as ADRs.

catalog.title: Add to the catalog
catalog.body: Package an app as a Compose-based template and share it with everyone.

sponsor.heading: Help keep Crustates independent.
sponsor.lead: Sponsorship pays for test hardware, CI and development time. [SPONSORSHIP MODEL TO BE DECIDED]

security.title: Security policy
security.body: Found a vulnerability? Report it privately through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting, never in a public issue. We agree a disclosure date with you and credit you in the advisory.

conduct.title: Code of conduct
conduct.body: Be kind, assume good intent and keep it about the work. It applies to every Crustates space.

licence.title: Licence
licence.body: The platform is AGPLv3. The API spec, client SDKs, plugin interfaces and the OpenTofu provider are Apache-2.0, so integrations can use any licence.

brand.heading: Running on Crustates? Show it.
brand.lead: Add the badge to your README or website. Logos, icons and banners are in the brand kit, with usage rules.
